label: Late-episode D2 at S2 after choosing a2, previous trial rewarded
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the inputs show action a2 and state S2 (an a2 -> S2 common transition) and the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew at D1 = 1; 99.8% of mass). Strongly gated by episode position: zero activity before ep_trial ~60, ramps up from 60-69, peaks at 80-89, drops at 90-99. The base conjunction (D2, a2, S2, prev rewarded) has recall ~1.0 but precision 0.18; adding ep_trial 72..95 brings dev P=0.65 R=0.95 F1=0.77 with mass recall 0.98. Never fires on D1/GO, on S1 or a1, after unrewarded trials, or early in the episode. Active steps have mid-range value (5.2-7.5, never the highest-value steps) and a moderate a2 policy preference (choice -9 to -1.5, never the most extreme); a value < 7.4 cut gave little extra. Every variable in the predicate is observed (ep_trial is elapsed time, which the GRU can track). The remaining false positives look like long a2 S2c rewarded streaks; I could not find a clean history variable that separates them, so precision stays incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+5.06), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 2 (9 = most a1) (+3.25), phase=D2 & before=a2 S1 r (+2.80), phase=D2 & last=a2 S1 r (+2.72), choice_bin=decile 2 (9 = most a1) (+2.52), phase=D2 & before=a2 S2 r (+2.42). Lower it: phase=D2 & value_bin=decile 9 (9 = highest) (-4.11), value_bin=decile 9 (9 = highest) (-4.11), phase=D2 & value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (-3.48), value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (-3.47).
